notes.title: Eldervale Patch Notes (1.2.3)
notes.notes:
Eldervale Patch Notes (1.2.3)

Base game

- Tokens required for the ultimate collection achievement reduced to 80 (was 100).

- Tokens required to unlock the Goldie costume reduced to 75 (was 100).

- Added a 101th token to Ophelia's room. With the updated value requirements, you need to collect a token to get the achievements.

Deep Reserves

- Added DLC button to Main Menu to make available content more clear.

- New objective: Get 10 kills. Rewards 1 rune. You will get this reward even if you die. Only usable until level 6.

- Removed multiple enemies from the second area to make the start of the DLC easier.

- Reduced kill requirements when using the Laboratory escape to 30 for 1 rune and 40 for 2 runes (was 40 and 50).

notes.title: Eldervale Patch Notes (1.2.2)
notes.notes:
Eldervale Patch Notes (1.2.2)

- After finishing Chapter 1, some parts of the level will be blocked off to avoid pointless backtracking. 
- The Elder Costume will now adapt to the base costume variation, changing it's color and texture.
- Equip Melee weapon now bound to the "4" key in addition to "0".
- Resources now spawn for twice as long during the bossfight.
- Default camera type is now "Medium" instead of "Far".
- SMG bullet spread reduced.
- If you fail to pick up the 2F or B1 maps, they will appear on a different place later in the game.
- Added camera events to the Statue, Patient and Dial puzzles when solved.
- Added a camera event near the SMG.
- You can no longer leave the basement before picking up the Handgun.

Originally, the entire level was accessible by the end of the game to provide shortcuts to previously visited save points or vending machines and get more "a-ha!" moments when returning to old areas. 
But this reward proved small, compared to the frustrating effect it had on some players who ended up backtracking to old areas that were irrelevant to progressing.


Deep Reserves DLC

- Objectives are now listed in inventory during gameplay.
- Start with more handgun ammo.
- Additional enemy reset points added.
- Mimic damage reduced by half.
- Stalkers can now be killed with candles.

notes.title: Eldervale Free DLC Update 1.2.0 - Deep Reserves
notes.notes:
Eldervale 1.2.0 - Deep Reserves

Hello everyone! Hope you're doing good!

Deep Reserves is a challenge map featuring branching paths, new enemies, plenty of secrets and it's own progression system. It takes place after the main game's events and you start with all weapons and equipment. It's recommended to tackle this content after completing the main game at least once. 

There are no save points in Deep Reserves, you have to reach an escape point or the very end to survive. 

Progression
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/665172b74b9d86f4e74c9e9128a2e2c1299b2df3.png

You have multiple ways of earning Elder Runes, a currency that can be spent after each run to increase your power permanently. The win conditions are tailored towards combat-oriented and speedrunner playstyles. You will have to kill as many enemies as you can or get to an escape point quickly to earn runes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/00a8c121540666a8ecdc85839b0341fb98259db9.png

There are also plenty of secrets, big and small. Finding more and more of these will make your attempts more manageable by providing you with ammo and healing items.    

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/0ec0fb7b375d806c050ce20a991131415f473abf.png

You will come across areas where you need to solve randomized puzzles. Finding the most optimal path around these sections can save you time to meet the requirements for a rune.

Win Conditions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/3774230223595e7f273644db7745a373be8b0941.png

These are subject to change as players will share their feedback. Here are a few current examples:

To gain 1 rune.

- Get 30 kills and escape through the Laboratory (around the 2/3 mark).

- Get to the escape point in under 10 minutes.

To gain 2 runes.

- Get 50 kills and escape through the Laboratory.

- Get to the escape point in under 5 minutes.

To gain 3 runes.

- Get 50 kills, reach the final area and kill the boss in under 15 minutes.


Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/c597bab24945e7eb72ab7db7945791a4bda34ae8.png

The main unlockable tied to Deep Reserves is the Elder costume. Once unlocked, it can be used in both the DLC and the main game. It's unique among the other costumes, as it can be equipped together with other skins. It is also animated and doubles as a light source.

You can unlock this costume by doing a single perfect run by killing the boss and many enemies under a tight time limit OR level up your profile to maximum.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/7f8eb6a23f3a47b64118185c5f960fab61e2b5ca.png

More Information

There are still many features and details I didn't cover like how the DLC fits into the story, new enemies, tips on how to rake up those Elder Runes and what's next to the DLC and the game in general. 

Many exciting things to share, keep an eye on the game's Steam page for updates, or join our Discord Community to ask me anything and provide quick feedback: 

https://discord.gg/VryNBv5

Deep Reserves is beta is now available! The other half of the DLC will arrive soon, during the season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/b94c963ed8503adab679e7b8cc77e76ff7b55ab1.png

Changelog for the upcoming patch:

- Deep Reserves beta is available to play.

- Field of View slider added.
- Camera Types option added.
- Default physics hair improved.

- Added sound effects when switching equipment.
- New sound effect for melee hits.
- New sound effects added for items.

- Torso enemies no longer have a hitbox when killed.

- Added new costume (Elder). Unlock it by reaching max level in Deep Reserves or doing a perfect run.
- Tokens needed to unlock the Goldie costume have been reduced from 100 to 75.

notes.title: Eldervale Upcoming 1.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Eldervale is near full release! Read on to learn about the major features coming with the update! 

Special Hard Mode
If you enjoy random events or looking for a reason to re-play the game, the new special mode may be just for you! In this mode, previously safe areas can become threatening in a blink of an eye, keeping you on your toes even on subsequent playthroughs. This mode can be enabled together with combat and puzzle hard modes for the ultimate "New Game+" experience.  It's recommended for players who already completed the game once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/74a5e5534de7e172f44d7234b07462e428f96ce5.png

Puzzle Hard Mode
Like the puzzles the game has to offer? Be prepared to be puzzled all over again, as puzzle hard difficulty reinvents all puzzles to be solved in a different way and removes all helpful clues you would have gotten in a normal playthrough. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/813e32280e54354962248cef79fa25a93e8cb2b3.png

Joystick Support
The support is built for the Xbox One controller but it is expected to be used with the configuration of your choice through Big Picture mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/d44bd77d78418783a633ec519e8cf690be911b53.png

Translation : Simplified Chinese
Thanks to two awesome members of the community and our hard work together, the game is getting a full Simplified Chinese translation! If you'd like to help out and make Eldervale available in your language, please feel free to contact me!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/00b7df09ee760dc074df22bd4ae1fe7264b19265.png

Beta Version
The beta version currently live, available to all owners of the game to try these new features right now!

You can access the beta by right-clicking Eldervale in your Steam Library, selecting properties and the Betas tab.

Discord Community
Join the Eldervale Discord to learn about future plans and updates firsthand, share your experiences and ask me or the community anything! 

Thank You
...for all the support, fair reviews and feedback! If you enjoy the game, please let others hear your thoughts about it and share it with people who might be interested so I can keep improving and bring you even better content. Cheers!

notes.title: Early Access Impending Release !
notes.notes:
Decided to give the game more crunch time to smooth out some of the frustrating parts, even though it's early access. Hope you don't mind a bit more waiting. I think it will be worth it to give something special to you all.

With the demo version of last year, I had the chance to hear from a large amount players for the first time since development started. It was a lot of fun to see and hear what you had to say about every little part of the game.

These are just some of the clips that made me laugh or feel that it was worth it. Credit for the entertainment value goes to the players in this one. I'd like to thank everyone who commented, shared, made a video on the game ! Get ready for much more when the full game launches very soon !
